items.title: Everything Is a Web Application, Including Your Firewall
items.description: One of the early targets of PHP2Shell exploitation was the firewall. On October 28, Palo Alto Networks confirmed that attackers were exploiting the two PHP vulnerabilities, CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, against PAN-OS management interfaces exposed to the internet. Both flaws let anyone execute code on the web server without authentication. The disclosure itself went a little wrong.

items.title: PHP Warns of Critical Security Flaws Affecting All Supported Versions, Fixes Coming November 19
items.description: The maintainers of the PHP programming language on Wednesday issued an advisory announcing an upcoming security release that addresses critical flaws. The release is scheduled for November 19, 2026, between 2 and 2:30 p.m. UTC.
